taskNotes: Aviansie assignments require completion of Death Plateau, access to the God Wars Dungeon, and the Watch the birdie unlock.
Watch the birdie requires 60 Agility or 60 Strength to unlock.
Aviansie can be found in the normal God Wars Dungeon and the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon.
As followers of Armadyl, Armadylean God-aligned items are required to make them tolerant.
Aviansie will attack players if attacked even while they are in combat with another monster.
Their flying height means they can only be harmed with ranged and magic, although salamanders and halberds are direct-target exceptions.
Aviansie drops mostly revolve around adamantite bars, runite limbs, ensouled aviansie heads, and poisoned rune daggers.
God Wars Dungeon Aviansie only drop noted adamantite bars after the Hard Fremennik Diary.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of diary completion but add player-killing risk.
Kree'arra and his bodyguards can be killed as alternatives for an Aviansie task.
Armadylean spiritual warrior, spiritual ranger, and spiritual mage kills do not count as Aviansie task alternatives.
Aviansie are usually toggled off unless killing Kree'arra because the regular task is generally unpopular.
At Kree'arra, bring an emergency teleport and consider banking at Nex after gathering Zarosian kill count.
Use an ecumenical key to avoid wasting time on Armadyl kill count when killing Kree'arra.
Accessing Kree'arra requires two extra inventory slots for a crossbow that can fire a mith grapple.
With max mage gear, an Eldritch nightmare staff, and optional Lightbearer, full Aviansie tasks can often be completed at Kree'arra without banking.
Reanimated aviansie can be killed as an alternative, but ensouled aviansie heads can be troublesome to obtain.
recommendedMethod: Range or mage regular Aviansie in God Wars Dungeon after Watch the birdie, wearing Armadyl-aligned protection. Use Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only when accepting player-killing risk. Kill Kree'arra instead when choosing boss profit over normal task completion.
